verses.1: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Son of God, born by God, also loves the one who was born from Him, as well as the One who was born through Him.
verses.2: In this, we learn that we love the children of God, when we love God and obey His commands.
verses.3: For this is the love of God, that we may obey His commands. And His commands are not difficult to obey.
verses.4: For everything that is created by God triumphs over the world. And that is the victory we must strive for: to win over the world. That’s our faith.
verses.5: Who is the one who can win the world, if he doesn’t believe that Jesus is indeed the Son of God?
verses.6: This is Jesus Christ, who came through water and blood. He isn’t only in the water, but also in both water and blood. And the Spirit is the witness that the Spirit truly represents the truth.
verses.8: The breath, as well as water and blood, and those three elements that come together to form one whole.
verses.9: If we accept the testimony of human beings, then the testimony of God is even more reliable. This is because it is the testimony of God itself, which speaks about His Son.
verses.10: Whoever believes in the Son of God has the testimony within him. But those who do not believe in God are liars, because they do not believe in the testimony that God gave regarding his Son.
verses.11: And this is the testimony that God has given us: He has given us eternal life. And this life lies in His Son.
verses.12: Whoever has a son has life; whoever does not have a son does not have life.
verses.13: I have written these things to you, so that you may know that you have eternal life. For those who believe in the name of the Son of God.
verses.14: And this is the kind of submission we have towards him: that if we ask for something according to his will, he will listen to us.
verses.15: And if we knew that he would listen to what we said when we made requests, then we would know that we had the right requests from him.
verses.16: If anyone sees his brother in a state of sin, but that sin isn’t deadly, then he should ask for forgiveness and give him life. For those who sin, it’s a sin that leads to death. I’m not saying that one should ask for forgiveness just because of that sin.
verses.17: All injustice is a sin. And it’s not a sin that leads to death.
verses.18: We know that every person born of God does not sin. Instead, those who are born of God keep God’s commands. And the wicked do not catch hold of them.
verses.19: We know that we are from God, and the whole world is under the control of the evil one.
verses.20: We know that the Son of God has come down from heaven, and He gave us the gift of wisdom so that we might know the truth. And this truth lies in His Son, Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
verses.21: Children, keep yourselves away from those idols.
